    if n <= 0:
        return 0
    # Count of n-digit numbers that start with 1
    start_count = 10 ** (n - 1)  # 1XXXX... (n-1 digits can be anything from 0-9)
    # Count of n-digit numbers that end with 1
    end_count = 10 ** (n - 1)     # XXXX...1 (n-1 digits can be anything from 0-9)
    # Count of n-digit numbers that both start and end with 1
    both_count = 10 ** (n - 2) if n > 1 else 0  # 1XXXX...1 (n-2 digits can be anything)
    # Total count is the sum of those starting with 1 and those ending with 1, minus those counted twice
    count = start_count + end_count - both_count
